title: Can a model learn developer taste in UI?
summary: Trained on what developers choose on 21st, Qwen started filling the screen, adding colour and building a whole page around one component.
body_markdown:
Time picker, 0.38 → 1.28, is the figure at the top of the post.


Looping shapes


> Build a single looping decorative animation built from shapes, not a page with animated sections and not a collection of different effects. It is for "Nimbus Weather", a hyperlocal forecast app. Required: one self-contained animated composition of at least 5 moving elements, a seamless infinite loop, and smooth easing. Visual style is up to you. Show only this component on the page: no headline, hero, navigation or other sections around it. Use a light theme.
